_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Logbooks and Records, Aircraft and Aeronautical Equipment
summary: Provides format and content instructions for aircraft logbooks and aeronautical equipment records used to document the service history of aircraft and aeronautical equipment being procured.
use_relationship:
Aircraft Logbooks and Aeronautical Equipment Records are utilized to document the service history of the aircraft and aeronautical equipment being procured. This Data Item Description (DID) allows for the tailoring of service or technical data to be included in an aircraft logbook or an aeronautical equipment record. This DID is applied to delivery of the aircraft and aeronautical equipment being procured. These records are prescribed for use with aircraft and aeronautical equipment (e.g., aircraft power plants, propellers, airborne auxiliary power units and other appropriate items of airborne equipment).

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.

This DID supersedes DI-MNTY-81067.

OPNAVINST 4790.2E may be ordered from:
Commanding Officer
Naval Aviation Maintenance Office (231)
Patuxent River, MD  20670-5466

Aircraft Logbooks and Aeronautical Equipment Record forms shall be procured from the Navy Supply System in accordance with procedures specified in NAVSUP Publication 2002.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Aircraft Logbook and Related Aeronautical equipment records shall be prepared in accordance with OPNAVINST 4790.2E.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The aircraft logbook and related aeronautical equipment records shall be made up of one or more of the following:

children.title: OPNAV Form 4790/26A - Installed Explosive Safety Devices
OPNAV Form 4790/28A - Scheduled Removal Component Card
OPNAV Form 4790/29 - Aeronautical Equipment Service Record (Separator)
OPNAV Form 4790/101 - Parachute Configuration Inspection and History Record
OPNAV Form 4790/113 - Equipment History Record (EHR) Card
OPNAV Form 4790/137 - RSSK/Seat Pan/ Soft Pack Survival Kit Configuration Inspection and History Record
OPNAV Form 4790/138 - History Card - Aviation Crew System
A Scheduled Removal Component Card shall be provided
children.content: for each component which has a scheduled removal interval as specified in the Periodic Maintenance Information Card for the applicable aircraft.
